title: Tooltips need a delay, and then they need to skip it
summary: This article explores UX best practices for tooltip behavior in web interfaces, advocating for implementing a delay before showing tooltips to prevent accidental triggers, while also explaining scenarios where that delay should be skipped (such as keyboard focus or touch devices).
problem_solved: Prevents annoying tooltips from appearing too quickly when users accidentally hover over interactive elements.
why_valuable: Improves user experience by reducing tooltip noise while maintaining accessibility for keyboard and touch users.
